# D74 Edits

> D74 Edits is a free football clip and live TV site: a clip library, search, a live channel browser, an embedded player, optional accounts and free downloads. Plain HTML/CSS/JS front end served by an Express server; Firestore stores records, Redis can cache them, and `yt-dlp` resolves downloads when a record has no direct file link.

D74 Edits is hosted at https://d74.onrender.com. The repository is a single Node.js/Express application with no build step; pages are static HTML files under the project root and shared assets live in `view/`.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://d74.onrender.com/): landing page and feature overview.
- [Explore](https://d74.onrender.com/explore/): clip feed, matches and channels.
- [Search](https://d74.onrender.com/search/): search the clip library.
- [Live TV](https://d74.onrender.com/livestreams/): live channel browser.
- [Clip detail](https://d74.onrender.com/visit/): player and free download (requires `?id=YOUTUBE_ID`).
- [Privacy Policy](https://d74.onrender.com/privacy/): how information is collected and used.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://d74.onrender.com/terms/): terms of use.
- [Admin](https://d74.onrender.com/Admin/): administrator control room (login required).

## Documentation

- [Production hosting guide](https://d74.onrender.com/production-hosting-docs.md): Render deployment, environment keys, Firebase/RapidAPI/Redis/yt-dlp/AdSense setup, keep-alive, troubleshooting and security checklist.
- [README](https://d74.onrender.com/README.md): project overview, setup, scripts and layout.
- [sitemap.xml](https://d74.onrender.com/sitemap.xml): sitemap for crawlers.
- [robots.txt](https://d74.onrender.com/robots.txt): crawler rules.

## API endpoints

- `/api/health`: lightweight health check used by Render and external keep-alive monitors.
- `/api/config`: public feature flags and AdSense identifiers.

## Optional context

- The free Render tier sleeps after 15 minutes of inactivity; an external request to `/api/health` every 10-14 minutes keeps it awake (see `.github/workflows/keep-alive.yml`).
- Environment variables are documented in `.env.example` and `production-hosting-docs.md`; secrets are never committed.
- Admin sessions are server-side, cookie-based and CSRF-protected.
